{{Top}}
A '''brood pouch''' was an abdominal slit where newborn [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlets]] were nourished and grew.<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> Most Huttlets stayed in the pouch for the first fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of their life, emerging with the mental development about that of a ten-year old [[Human/Legends|Human]]. For their first year of development, newborn Huttlets never left the pouch. Over the next fifty years, Huttlets could stay outside the pouch for gradually longer periods of time. Since this lengthy development phase often distracted Hutt mothers from their occupational duties, [[Communal nursery|communal nurseries]] were available on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where surrogate [[pouch-mother]]s could hold the huttlets of other mothers in their pouches for a couple of hours each day. Unlike most Huttlets, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] did not stay in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|his father's]] brood pouch. Jabba preferred his offspring to directly experience the galaxy first-hand, such a thing being almost unheard of in modern Hutt society.
